hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: Implements a buyback-and-burn mechanism with two swap-time actions: SHIELD absorbs main-token sells from the pot at the pool's exact execution price (via beforeSwap delta), and PUMP buys main with pot funds on each buy swap (via afterSwap self-call). Pools can optionally run an LP program with auto-harvesting and auto-compounding of trading fees.
